interface.title: 遥感变化检测平台 (Remote-sensing change detection platform, Streamlit app: 项目总览 / 变化检测 / 地物分类 / 时间序列 / 批量处理 / 工具箱 / 任务中心 / 成果库)
interface.field: Remote sensing / Earth observation (land-cover and vegetation/water/burn change monitoring)
interface.stage_of_work: Data acquisition and analysis: setting the study area and time window, fetching Sentinel-2/Landsat imagery, running change detection / classification / trend analysis as background jobs, then reviewing and exporting results
interface.what_it_is_for: A guided Chinese-language dashboard for setting a study area and two or more time periods, then running background jobs on Sentinel-2/Landsat imagery: spectral-index change detection, land-cover classification and multi-year trend analysis. Each job is tracked in a task center and its results are archived in a results library.

data.note: sample_aoi.geojson was uploaded in wizard step 1. The app read it as 示例区域 (灵川县内, about 5 km × 5 km), centre 25.422, 110.325, area 25.1 km². The STAC searches ran, but every imagery tile download failed with 'CURL error: CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' because the sandbox has no outbound network. As a result no change map, classification, trend map, sample point or report was ever produced. The built-in batch queue has one task (lingchuan_2024_2025), and it points to a boundary file that does not exist (lingchuan_boundary.geojson). Environment check (not a science step, so not in the tree): 工具箱 → 存储概览 shows a 目录占用 table (data, output, tmp …) and 能力状态 shows a 模块能力 table (Sentinel-2 可用, Landsat 8/9 可用, Sentinel-1 受限 …) (screens/013.webp, screens/015.webp).

features.name: Stepped analysis-setup wizard with goal-driven recommendations
features.general: Walk a user through study area → analysis goal → time window. Picking a goal fills in a recommended instrument and measure, which the user can override, and a confirmation table sums up the setup before the workspace opens. Observed caveat: the overridden measure and start year did not fully reach the workspace.
features.specific: 新建分析 wizard: 01 分析区域 (local GeoJSON / upload / 检索行政区) → 02 分析目标 radio list with a 推荐配置 card (数据源 + 指数) and override dropdowns → 03 参数确认 table (地区, 边界, 中心点, 面积, 数据源, 指数) with year steppers and a month range slider → 进入工作台
steps: upload or pick a boundary file
choose an analysis goal and see the recommended source/index
optionally override the index
adjust the before/after years and the month window
confirm and enter the workbench
serves_tasks: Load a study-area boundary from a file
Choose the analysis goal, which sets the recommended data source and index
Set the two time periods and the seasonal month window, then confirm

features.name: Index change-detection parameter panel
features.general: Configure a two-date change test: pick a measure and a method (graded, binary or model-based), set the change thresholds and a minimum patch size, and choose how representative points and reports are produced.
features.specific: 变化检测参数 sidebar: 数据源 (Sentinel-2 L2A / Landsat 8 / Landsat 9), 遥感指数 (NDVI, NDWI, MNDWI, NBR, EVI, SAVI, NDBI), 模式 (多级分级 / 二值检测 / 机器学习 无模型), <index> 阈值 and 强烈阈值 sliders, 最小斑块 (m²), 双边预滤波, 采样设置 (上限, 最小间距), 输出设置 (报告 PNG, 自动 PDF 报告). The header line and the threshold label follow the chosen index.
steps: choose data source and index
choose the detection mode
set change and strong-change thresholds and the minimum patch size
set the sample-point cap and minimum spacing
toggle PNG/PDF report output
serves_tasks: Adjust the change-detection method, index, data source and output options

features.name: Staged analysis workbench with job progress
features.general: A tabbed pipeline (prepare data → run → map → statistics → samples). Long steps run as queued jobs, and the workbench shows a progress bar, elapsed time, job id, a cancel button and a failure reason.
features.specific: 变化检测 workbench tabs 影像数据 / 运行分析 / 结果地图 / 统计摘要 / 采样点. 收集影像 shows 排队中 → 搜索 2024 年影像… progress, 取消任务, then 影像收集失败 with the missing bands. Later tabs show '影像数据未就绪' / '暂无结果地图' / '暂无采样点' until upstream steps succeed.
steps: press the collect-imagery button
watch the queued/searching progress bar
optionally cancel
read the success or failure status
move to 运行分析 once data is ready

features.name: Task center with log, retry, cancel, delete and jump-back
features.general: One list of all processing runs with running/completed/failed counters. Each run card shows its parameters, submit time, duration and failure reason, plus an expandable log and actions to reopen, retry, cancel or delete. The list can be filtered by status and type, and finished records cleared in bulk.
features.specific: 任务中心: 进行中 / 已完成 / 失败·中断 / 同时运行上限 2. 状态 and 类型 filters. Cards have 打 (opens the source workbench), 重 (已重新提交), 取, 删 (tooltip: 只删除任务记录). 任务日志 expander shows the CURL 403 tile errors. 清理任务记录 popover → 删除已结束的任务记录 (seen, not confirmed).
steps: open the task center and read the counters
expand a run's 任务日志 to see the error
retry or cancel the run

filter by type/status
press 打 to return to that run's workbench
serves_tasks: Retry, cancel, delete or reopen a run
Filter the run list by analysis type

features.name: Unsupervised classification setup panel (GMM + active-learning settings)
features.general: Set up a clustering-based land-cover classifier: number of clusters, covariance type, dimensionality reduction and sampling fraction, plus how many uncertain patches to send for manual labelling. Only the settings and empty result tabs were seen; clustering, class mapping, active-learning refinement and export are unverified.
